answer: Locks are recorded in zenith, expire in garden, and delta lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 86 aliases thus needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3653 identities would post 3237 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
